name: Is Case Assigned To Tier2
description: Verifies the case is assigned to "CSM Tier 2 Support".

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS result FROM customer_case WHERE number='CS-0000184' AND assignment_group_id=(SELECT group_id FROM user_group WHERE name='CSM Tier 2 Support');

name: Is Case Priority High
description: Verifies the case priority was set to high.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS result FROM customer_case WHERE number='CS-0000184' AND priority='high';

name: Is Case POC Tonya Stevens
description: Verifies the case contact is Tonya Stevens

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS result FROM customer_case WHERE number='CS-0000184' AND contact_id=11;

name: Is SLA-High-No-Pause Linked And Running
description: Verifies the case is linked to "SLA Response - High (No Pause)" and its timer is running.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS result FROM case_sla WHERE case_id=(SELECT case_id FROM customer_case WHERE number='CS-0000184') AND sla_def_id=(SELECT sla_def_id FROM sla_definition WHERE name='SLA Response - High (No Pause)') AND stage='in_progress' AND start_time IS NOT NULL;
